refusal.title: We can't use this file yet

t01.title: Create a lesson set from your material
t01.lede: LOGINA reads your material first, asks you about anything unclear, and only then drafts 5 tasks. You approve the source once and the tasks once before assigning.
t01.fileHint: PDF or Word · up to 20 MB
t01.languageHint: Tasks and Think-again prompts use the material's language. LOGINA does not translate material.
t01.subject: Subject
t01.structureNote: The structure is fixed, so tasks can be compared across lessons.
t01.noMaterial: Choose a file or use the sample material.

t02.liveTiming: New material can take a few minutes to read. You can leave and come back.

language.question: Your file looks like {{detected}}. Use {{detected}} for this lesson?

t02.title: Analyzing material…
t02.lede: At this step LOGINA only reads and cross-checks the source; it does not write tasks yet.
t02.timing: Usually takes 1–2 minutes. You can leave this page; LOGINA will let you know when the analysis is done.
t02.notAnalyzedNote: The analysis was stopped or didn't finish. You can start it again.

t05.readByAiNotice: LOGINA read this file with AI. Check the quoted text and figures against your original before approving.
t05.title: Source review
t05.located: Every claim has a location in the source
t05.note: Only after approval does LOGINA write the 5 tasks from this source version. Editing the source later creates a new version for you to approve again.

t03.title: Clarify material
t03.lede: LOGINA found {{count}} points that could make an answer or the lesson goal wrong. Resolve or exclude every blocker before approving the source.
t03.alwaysShown: Blockers are always shown, never collapsed.
t03.unchanged: The original material always stays unchanged. Your decisions are saved separately, with a history.
t03.suggestions: AI suggestions, with evidence from the source
t03.blocked: Resolve or exclude every blocker to continue.

t06.title: Evidence sufficiency and task generation
t06.lede: Each task is checked on its own: does the source support the correct answer, ruling out the wrong options, and the Think-again prompt?
t06.wait: Drafting from your own file can take up to 15 minutes. Keep this page open; finished drafts appear here as they're ready.
t06.othersContinue: Other tasks are still being drafted

choice.ADD_SOURCE: Add a source on labor productivity
choice.LEAVE_EMPTY: Leave Q4 empty in this set

choiceNote.REFOCUS: Use what the source already has.
choiceNote.ADD_SOURCE: Go back to the source step; Source review is needed again.
choiceNote.LEAVE_EMPTY: The lesson set won't have 5 tasks, so it can't be assigned yet.

t07.tryHint: Choose as a student would to see which Think-again prompt appears
t07.tryNote: Shows only the prompt the student gets, not the selection rules.
t07.question: QUESTION
t07.oneEach: In each attempt, a student gets exactly 1 prompt.

t08.title: Q1 logic check
t08.invalidates: Saving creates a new draft, marks the preview as outdated, and rechecks the affected pairs and prompts.

t09.title: The preview is outdated because you just edited it.
t09.body: LOGINA is rechecking the affected parts. Q2 to Q5 keep their status, and the approved source stays the same.

t10.title: Edit source
t10.lede: Editing here creates a new source version. The earlier version and assigned tasks stay as they are.
t10.cancel: Cancel and keep the current source

t11.refused: The new sentence includes something that isn't in the approved source. Quick edit is for wording only, not for adding new facts.
t11.keepWording: Remove the figure, keep the wording
t11.conflict: Someone else saved changes first. Your changes weren't saved so they don't overwrite that version.
t11.failed: LOGINA couldn't finish checking this version. An earlier Pass isn't reused.

t12.title: Task approval
t12.lede: Approve each task exactly as students will receive it. Blockers must be fixed. Teaching warnings can be fixed or accepted with a reason.
t12.stillSays: The machine result still says “Needs review”, not “Pass”. The decision is saved with your name and the time.
t12.confirm: I have reviewed {{slot}} exactly as students will receive it.

change.PREVIEW_CHANGED: This task changed since you last viewed it.

why.blockers: Fix the blockers before you approve.
why.warnings: Decide on the warnings before you approve.
why.status: Wait for the checks to finish.

t13.title: Assign
t13.lede: All 5 tasks are approved. Assigning only sends the locked version to students; it is not another content approval.
t13.noTimer: Students only see the due date. There is no countdown timer.
t13.pinned: Student attempts always use exactly these versions.

t14.title: Attempt tracking
t14.lede: These figures show what students chose and changed, based on the exact releases assigned ({{releases}}).
t14.disclaimer: Revision rates, rising confidence or correct choices are not enough to conclude that students learned better. That needs a separate evaluation design.
t14.empty: No one has submitted a task yet.
t14.promptsNote: How often each prompt was shown, and how often students revised after it. This shows what happened next, not why.

t15.disclaimer: The trace records choices, the Think-again prompt given and any changes. It does not show why the student changed their mind.

consent.title: Taking part in research
consent.about: We want to understand how people think again about their answers and their confidence after a short prompt.
consent.record: We record your choices before and after the prompt, your confidence, when you lock in and submit, and what you write in Q5.
consent.names: We don't ask for your name or email. Please don't type personal details in your written answer.
consent.data: The data is copied to a Google Sheet the team can read, and may be used in a research paper. Results describe groups only, never one person.
consent.limit: The data doesn't show why anyone changed their mind, and doesn't prove anyone learned more.
consent.who: The LOGINA team runs this study. Contact: logina.edu@gmail.com.
consent.kept: The data is kept until the paper is published, and for no more than 2 years from collection. Then we delete it.
consent.choice: Taking part is your choice. The tasks work the same either way.
consent.withdraw: To withdraw, email your participant code to logina.edu@gmail.com. We will delete your rows.
consent.once: You choose once for this session.
consent.keepCode: Keep this code. It also appears on your results page.
